DEFINE INSTRUMENT t2_sans_collimation(
  r_pin1 = 0.0058,
  r_pin2 = 0.0058
)

DECLARE
%{
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
%}

MCPLIB

TRACE

COMPONENT origin = Progress_bar()
AT (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT source = Source_simple(
  radius = 0.04,
  dist = 3.0,
  focus_r = r_pin1,
  lambda0 = 6.0,
  dlambda = 0.05
)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE origin

COMPONENT pin1 = Circular_mask(
  radius = r_pin1
)
AT (0, 0, 3.0) RELATIVE origin

COMPONENT pin2 = Circular_mask(
  radius = r_pin2
)
AT (0, 0, 6.0) RELATIVE origin

COMPONENT sample = Sans_spheres(
  R = 200,
  p_inter = 0.0,
  phi = 0.01,
  delta_rho = 3.0,
  sigma_abs = 0.5,
  xwidth = 2*r_pin2,
  yheight = 2*r_pin2,
  zdepth = 0.002
)
AT (0, 0, 6.001) RELATIVE origin

COMPONENT beamstop = Beamstop(
  radius = 0.020
)
AT (0, 0, 8.99) RELATIVE origin

COMPONENT detector = PSD_monitor(
  filename = "detector.dat",
  xwidth = 0.6,
  yheight = 0.6,
  nx = 128,
  ny = 128
)
AT (0, 0, 9.0) RELATIVE origin

END
